drills.name: Ladder in-and-outs
drills.howto: Agility ladder, two feet in, two feet out, down and back, staying on the balls of the feet.
drills.cue: Feet wide, chest up, stay balanced.

drills.name: 1-2 step into shot
drills.howto: Catch on the move, plant inside foot then outside foot, square up and shoot.
drills.cue: Land balanced before the ball goes up.

drills.name: One-hand form shooting
drills.howto: Stand close to the rim and shoot with the shooting hand only, holding the follow-through.
drills.cue: Relaxed hand, reach into the cookie jar.

drills.name: Pound dribble series
drills.howto: Hard dribbles at knee height, 30 seconds each hand, then crossover.
drills.cue: Fingertips, not palm. Keep the wrist loose.

drills.name: Single-leg balance reach
drills.howto: Balance on one leg and reach the other foot forward, side and back.

drills.name: Soft-landing drop jumps
drills.howto: Step off a low box and land on two feet, holding the landing for two seconds.
drills.cue: Knees push out over the toes, never in.

drills.name: 90/90 hip switches
drills.howto: Seated with both knees bent at 90°, rotate the knees side to side under control.
drills.cue: Tall spine, move from the hips.

drills.name: Dead bug
drills.howto: On your back, arms and knees up, extend the opposite arm and leg while keeping the lower back flat.
drills.cue: Ribs down, back glued to the floor.
